facts.fact: ONECI, the national civil status and identification office, opened a national ID card enrolment centre at the Madrid embassy on 11 May 2026 and connected it to the national civil-status network, with the CityWeb civil-status software, so one body runs both.

CIV.note: Nothing stated on a business register.

facts.fact: ONECI says the national civil-status software CityWeb is being deployed in all civil-status centres, and issued its first act from Madrid on 11 May 2026 to a couple transcribing their child's Spanish birth record.

CIV.note: Nothing stated on a voters' roll.
No count or share of people enrolled is given; only about 5,000 Ivorians in Spain are estimated.
No number given at birth is stated.
Nothing stated on who operates, maintains or owns the system.
No register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: ONECI opened a national ID card enrolment centre at the Ivorian embassy in Madrid on 11 May 2026, its 14th centre abroad in 12 countries, and handed receipts to the first people enrolled.

CIV.note: Only a passing mention of e-justice nationality certificates; no court case system stated.

facts.fact: ONECI states that its Madrid centre is connected to the national register of natural persons (RNPP) from 12 May 2026.
